anomalies.observed: Sheet 1, section 'Water Level Sensor/Switches', shows PR5 LiDAR connected through H2 to +5V, NET0008, NET0062, and GND, i.e. wired onto the main I2C bus.
anomalies.expected: The specification states the TF-Luna LiDAR is present in the BOM but not wired: 'its pins are "free" and it is marked on_board: no / excluded from the board; it is not wired into any net.' The intended wired water-level sensing is the HC-SR04-style ultrasonic sensor on two GPIOs.

evidence.quote: Sheet 1, 'Water Level Sensor/Switches': PR5 LiDAR pins VCC/SDA/SCL/GND connected to +5V, NET0008, NET0062, GND via H2
TF-Luna LiDAR ... pins are 'free' and it is marked on_board: no / excluded from the board; it is not wired into any net.

anomalies.impact: Adds an unexpected I2C device/load to the main bus and replaces the specified ultrasonic water-level sensing path with a LiDAR interface, so level sensing and bus behavior differ from the intended design.

anomalies.observed: The net label NET0088 appears on U9 pin 24 (OA1, a pH peristaltic-pump coil output) and also on the ATO-valve gate-drive path at R50/T3 base.
anomalies.expected: TMC2209 coil outputs should connect only to the pump connector, and ATO_VALVE should be a separate control net driven from the MCU through R50/T3. The specification separates stepper coil outputs from the ATO valve switch.

evidence.quote: Sheet 2, 'Ph ↓ Pump': U9 pin 24 OA1 is labeled NET0088 and connects to H5 pin 1
Sheet 3, 'ATO Valve': R50 input is labeled NET0088 and connects to T3 base
each drives a 2-phase coil output (/A_xx+/-, /B_xx+/-) to connectors H7/H8/H9 ... T3 — AON6407 ... drives ATO_VALVE net

anomalies.impact: The pH pump coil output is shorted into the ATO valve gate-drive circuit, so stepper operation can inadvertently drive the valve and the valve control can load the motor driver, potentially causing incorrect dosing/ATO behavior or driver damage.

parsed.summary: The schematic contains at least one clear deviation: the TF-Luna LiDAR is wired to the main I2C bus even though the specification says it is not wired. It also appears to merge the NET0088 net between a TMC2209 coil output and the ATO valve gate drive, which is a separate connectivity anomaly.
